item.description: Two new Garmin smartwatch updates, software versions 19.23 and 19.24, have arrived for several of the brand’s wearables. The releases bring new activity-related features and improvements linked to swimming to users of the Forerunner 70, Forerunner 170 and Forerunner 970 smartwatches.
